title: Shimon ben Avtolmus
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Bava Batra 68a, explaining what "sanṭer" (סנטר) means; Hyman infers that he is an Amora of the Land of Israel ("Yerushalmi"). Dikdukei Soferim reads "ben Avshalom."[^1][^2][^3]

notes.text: סח. gives 68a by convention without fresh passage verification.
דק״ס is contextually Dikdukei Soferim; ben Avshalom is Hyman’s attributed alternate patronymic, without new collation or identity inference.

Sanṭer remains transliterated because Hyman supplies no definition. ומשמע is Hyman’s inference; Yerushalmi is understood regionally as Land of Israel, not proof of Jerusalem residence. Amora is a supplied classification and adds no Rabbi title.
